description: Oil and Gas - Earth Resources Spatial Data Collection for the Datamart. is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Energy, Environment and Climate Action. Oil and gas facilities, oil and/or gas pipelines, oil and or/gas fields and the Petroleum Act Graticule. Collected for Earth Resources within DSDBI. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Department of Energy, Environment and Climate Action. Its tags are Geoscientific information. It offers 7 resource(s) in DWG, DXF, EXTENDED TAB, GDB, MIF. The portal shows 2026-09-27 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support fuel supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
